verdict.rationale: Vestd markets a 'Migrate to Vestd' offering to digitise or move an existing scheme, and positions itself as replacing 'messy spreadsheets scattered across your team' with 'one source of truth, reconciled,' implying migration support. However there is no evidence of a guided import workflow, validation steps, or reconciliation against source documents — these are just marketing taglines, not documented process detail. Missing for 10: guided import UI/steps, data validation rules, reconciliation process against source spreadsheets/documents, any case study or hands-on account of a migration.
